svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lower tube: 32 x 3 fibreglass, 1000 long; one 10.5 hole across, 50 below its top

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upper tube: 25.4 x 3.2 fibreglass, 1100 long; it slides inside the lower tube

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (0.3 clearance each side); sixteen 10.5 holes, 50 apart, the first 150 up

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from its bottom end; all holes in one line, square to the tube

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slot across the top of the upper tube: 12.5 wide, 60 deep (as the socket slots)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fork plate: 12 HDPE, 100 wide; notch 50 wide, round bottom R25, 30 above the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tube top; tongue 25.4 wide, 60 long into the slot; round all edges

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two nylon M8 bolts through tube and tongue, 15 and 45 below the tube top

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rubber foot cap; red band 850 to 900 up from the foot; hold below the band

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Notch height 1.19 to 1.94 m in 50 steps; 1.24 m long when closed

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seal cut ends and hole bores with epoxy; no metal anywhere in the prop

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: upper tube slides freely; the pin goes through at every hole
